articles.title: Chrome Enterprise and Education release notes - Google Help
articles.content: For administrators who manage Chrome browser or ChromeOS devices for a business or school. Select the required tab to see Chrome browser or ChromeOS updates. DOWNLOAD Release notes (PDF)  back to top The enterprise release notes are available in 9 languages. You can read about Chromes updates in English, German, French, Dutch, Spanish, Portuguese, Korean, Indonesian, and Japanese. Allow 1 to 2 weeks for translation for some languages. Building on our commitment to security, ChromeOS now provides greater transparency into your devices data recovery history. Every recovery attempt is logged into a tamper-evident, privacy-preserving ledger, and we are now making it possible for that log to be reviewed. This allows you to verify that all attempts to recover local data on your device were made by you, ensuring unauthorized access attempts are easily detected and giving you complete peace of mind. Admins can now use two new permissions policies to restrict access to the Device Attributes API. The Device Attributes API is available for policy-installed kiosk web apps and policy-installed Isolated Web Apps (IWAs) only, on managed ChromeOS devices only. Additionally, the feature is controlled by content settings. Two new policies are introduced, DeviceAttributesBlockedForOrigins and DefaultDeviceAttributesSetting, to complement the previously-introduced DeviceAttributesAllowedForOrigins policy. The feature is enabled by default for the supported scenarios described above. You can now take direct control of your Chromebooks battery health to extend its lifespan with new charging optimization settings. These features help preserve your batterys long-term health by adjusting how your device charges. To configure these user-accessible options, navigate to Settings  Device  Power and select Change next to Optimized Charging. You can choose between: This update is the user-facing counterpart to the DevicePowerBatteryChargingOptimization policy available in the Google Admin console. Administrators can set this policy to one of three options: The policy set by an administrator overrides any setting selected by the user. A user can only benefit from adjusting the charge optimization options on their device if no overriding policy is enforced. By default, if no policy is enforced, Optimized Charging is enabled on the device with the Adaptive Charging option selected. For more information, see How to use Adaptive charging - Chromebook Help. Currently, there are 2 ways to set up a printer driverless configuration, or manufacturer and model. This new feature provides a third way to identify a printer, which is by using a custom PPD file. ChromeOS enterprise administrators can now specify custom PPD files when setting up managed printers for their organizations.  back to top Sign up for emails about future releases Chrome version  targeted Stable channel release date

articles.title: Copy apps data from an Android to a new Android device
articles.content: When you set up your new device, you can move your data from your old Android device to your new Android device. Important: Turn on your Android device and tap Start. Tip: You can change your phones language or vision settings now if needed. Tip: To copy apps and data on your new Android device, tap Copy. Follow the on-screen instructions to connect both devices with a cable. Important: If you dont have a compatible cable, you may need to use an adapter or use the wireless method. Tip: If you dont have a compatible cable or an adapter, you can still copy your apps and data with a wireless connection. Tip: If you dont have your old device available, you can restore from a previous backup of your old device stored in your Google Account. Learn how to back up or restore data on your Android device. Tip: To find backups available to restore, you need to turn on backups on your old device.

articles.title: Customize your New Tab page in Chrome
articles.content: Depending on your default search engine, you may be able to control what appears below the search box on your New Tab page. To customize your New Tab page, you must be signed in to your Google Account and use Google as your default search engine. In some countries, you may need to manage your linked Google services to use Chrome history for personalization and other services. When you open a new tab, under the search box, you can find websites you visit often or shortcuts to websites you chose. Tip: Suggested articles dont appear on your homepage on your computer. You can choose from theme categories and special collections or upload an image to use as a background in Chrome. Chrome automatically suggests a browser color based on the image you upload or the theme you select. If you dont like the suggested color, under Appearance, pick a different color. To reset the theme, at the bottom of the panel, select Reset to Default Chrome. Learn more about Dark mode or Dark theme. To create themes with AI, learn how to customize Chrome themes with AI. Chrome curates content that may interest you based on your activity. You must be signed in to your Google Account for your Cards to appear on the New Tab page. When you click on an item in a card, it opens the content in the same tab. With Chrome Cards, you can: One way your Chrome browser history and searches are organized is by group. You can easily resume browsing by clicking a card: Open a new group of tabs, which includes your initial search and relevant web pages. Remove a specific search from the New Tab page until you decide to search for it again. Learn more about resuming browsing. When you browse on multiple devices, you can easily resume browsing the last open tabs from any of your devices on your current device. articles.title: Transfer WhatsApp data to a new Android - Google Help
articles.content: You can transfer WhatsApp chats and data from your old iPhone or Android to your new Android device. Important: To transfer data from an Android device to a new Android device: Important: If you transferred apps from your old device to your new Android, WhatsApp should be installed on your new device. If you dont have WhatsApp installed: When prompted to restore your data, youll be given two choices: Tips: Tip: Any new messages received on your new device will be lost. Important: You cant merge chat history created on a new phone with chat history previously created on your old phone. If you restore your old chat history, it replaces any new chat history you created on your new phone. To retrieve your old message history: You cant transfer your WhatsApp data to a new phone number. However, you can change your phone number on your old device to your new phone number before you transfer it to your new phone. Tip: Other data migration apps arent supported and can cause migration issues. WhatsApp doesnt delete your data during a transfer and your data wont be lost if an error occurs.
